entities.summary: Pierfrancesco di Lorenzo de' Medici (1487–1525), known also as Pierfrancesco II de' Medici or Pierfrancesco il Giovane  to distinguish him by his grandfather Pierfrancesco, was an Italian banker and a member of the House of Medici.
